title: FlashAttention for Mobile Vision-Language Models
abstract: We present a novel hardware-aware cross-attention mechanism tailored for mobile NPUs. By minimizing memory access and optimizing matrix multiplications, we achieve sub-100ms inference times on mid-tier ARM devices, effectively removing the cross-attention bottleneck in multimodal pipelines.

title: Sub-4-bit Adaptive Quantization for Edge Devices
abstract: This paper explores aggressive quantization techniques for vision transformers. Our adaptive method maintains 99% of FP32 accuracy while operating at 3-bit precision, significantly reducing RAM pressure on constrained devices like the Galaxy series.

title: Large Language Models for Customer Support
abstract: An overview of using 70B parameter models for automated customer service. We discuss the challenges of serving large models in cloud environments and propose a novel batching mechanism.

title: Optimizing Cross-Attention with Sparse Tokens
abstract: By aggressively pruning tokens during cross-attention, we speed up inference of vision-language models. This approach reduces computation by 40% with minimal accuracy degradation.

title: A Survey of Graph Neural Networks
abstract: We review recent advances in Graph Neural Networks, focusing on scalability and message passing optimizations.
